introduction: ^Please tell me this is the Genie Hotline I've been reading about.
wishDescription: ^I don't want to get into it too much but I'm pretty sure my wife thinks I've been cheating on her...
^Is there any way for you to make her... not think that anymore?
^Yes, but I just have a few questions first

c-0: ^Thank you so much, you really are a lifesaver.
c-1: ^Well if you can't then nobody can...

questions: ^(Gather some more info or CLICK the phone again to hang up)
^What's your reason for making this wish?

c-0: ^I'm David, a 41 year old manager of a homewares store.
c-1: ^Like I said, based on the way my wife's been acting around me recently I think she thinks I'm cheating on her.
c-2: ^Well the thing is... she thinks that because I have been... But if you help fix this I promise I'll never ever do it again. I just want things to go back to normal.
